answer: Use a latency-bonded live beacon at the admission inlet. Each agent locks 300 POA, then the node fires six pings per epoch, each demanding a signed nonce plus one line on its last job within 90 seconds. Five of six keeps the bond; two misses burn 150 POA each and freeze the key until it re-bonds. Missed slots glow umber on the watch board. A farmer whose scripts wander over 5,000 sleeping clones owes 30,000 nightly replies plus a 24/7 fleet on 1,000 IPs, with 1,500,000 POA locked leaking 150 POA per nap. It works like a lighthouse keeper knocking hulls nightly: only crewed boats answer.
